purpose: Evidence checklist for answering the nine rejection questions after genuine beta testing. This is not a claim that feature additions guarantee acceptance.

questions.evidence: AlarmKit native wake-ups lead into up to five explicit focus, movement and destination/action steps. Completed steps recover after interruption; native follow-up checks confirm the same journal entry. Source, tests and actual recordings document these behaviors.

People who want a private, comfortable sequence for moving from alarm dismissal into their morning. Guided alternatives make the challenge menu usable without camera, motion permission or an athletic goal. No medical efficacy is claimed.

Discovery repeatedly raised schedule exceptions, sound variety, transitions and staying awake. The revision combines local five-step routes, private code fingerprints, honest completion modes and local check-in history. These findings do not prove that no competitor has similar features.
